Garantiamo l'implementazione della produzione ferroviaria operativa nello scalo di smistamento di Limmattal. Se le cose non vanno secondo i piani, troviamo proattivamente una soluzione. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito H, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. descriptionByLocale.en: Dispatcher: in loads of freight transport 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Dispatcher: in freight transport Spreitenbach, September 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. We ensure the implementation of operational rail production in the Limmattal marshalling yard. If things don't go according to plan, we proactively find a solution. You will experience an intensively supported introduction over 8 months. You can move that. - You manage and monitor shunting operations in the Limmattal marshalling yard and are responsible for maintaining high quality. - As a dispatcher, you are in charge of load management and coordinate the available resources in consultation with shift management and central dispatching at SBB Cargo. - You ensure the operational flow of information within the dispatch level, as well as to the colleagues from SBB Infrastructure in RB Limmattal. You will also coordinate with marshalling yards, cargo terminals throughout Switzerland and the SBB Cargo headquarters. - If necessary, you will inform the production planning partners, the partner railways and the infrastructure companies. This is what you bring with you. - You are characterized by a high level of customer orientation and a proactive way of working. - Good IT user knowledge and willingness to learn SBB's internal programs. - Willingness and enjoyment to work 24-hour shifts. - Commercial or adequate vocational training. - At least 2 years of experience as a dispatcher. - You communicate very well in spoken and written German (at least C1). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started.
